scenario: A stale or replayed safety command is accepted
controls: Command ID uniqueness; TTL; clock-skew check; negative tests
residual_risk: Low if identity and time source are strengthened in production

scenario: Old or out-of-order telemetry drives an incorrect state decision
controls: Per-aircraft monotonic sequence; timestamp window; range validation
residual_risk: Medium because the lab does not cryptographically authenticate frames

scenario: Incorrect geofence or restricted-zone configuration approves an unsafe route
controls: Boundary tests; independent configuration review; versioned settings
residual_risk: Medium until signed configuration and dual approval are implemented

scenario: Simplified battery estimate overstates recovery margin
controls: Conservative reserve; hardware-in-loop calibration planned; FMEA
residual_risk: High for real flight; acceptable only because this lab is non-operational

scenario: Static local token is reused or disclosed
controls: Role separation; environment override; no production claim
residual_risk: Medium; replace with short-lived identity in any deployment

scenario: A compromised dependency or CI action enters the build
controls: Dependabot; pip-audit; CodeQL; pinned major actions; review
residual_risk: Medium; add signed provenance and SBOM for release builds

scenario: Local in-memory audit events are lost or altered after process compromise
controls: Hash chain; integrity metric; remote write-once logging recommended
residual_risk: High for certification evidence; acceptable for a portfolio lab

scenario: Rapid link degradation causes delayed recovery decision
controls: Threshold tests; deterministic fail-safe; performance baseline
residual_risk: Medium; real radio behavior is outside scope

scenario: A misleading confidence value is treated as trustworthy
controls: Confidence threshold; hold behavior; source authentication planned
residual_risk: Medium to high without sensor fusion or model monitoring

scenario: An aircraft in maintenance is accidentally assigned a mission
controls: Mission gate rejects maintenance mode; regression test

scenario: Civil aviation guidance is incorrectly presented as military certification
controls: Explicit scope notes; official-source links; no certification claim
residual_risk: Low if documentation is kept current

controls: Pydantic field bounds; waypoint limit; performance tests
residual_risk: Medium; rate limiting and gateway limits remain future work
